title: Exanimate
summary: EXAN'IMATE, adjective egzan'imate. [Latin exanimatus, exanimo; ex and anima, life.] Lifeless; spiritless; disheartened; depressed in spirits. EXAN'IMATE, verb transitive To dishearten; to discourage.
